question.text: When rain is accompanied by a thunderstorm, the collected rain water will have a $\mathrm{pH}$ value

options.text: slightly higher than that when the thunderstorm is not there
which depends on the amount of dust in air
slightly lower than that of rain water without thunderstorm

solution.text: The rain water after thunderstorm contains dissolved acid and therefore the $\mathrm{pH}$ is less than rain water without thunderstorm.
